infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock OpenCode Mobile (ZeroTier Edition) and access your sessions securely.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OpenCode Mobile (ZeroTier Edition) uses speech recognition so you can dictate prompts to your AI coding agent hands-free.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OpenCode Mobile (ZeroTier Edition) uses the microphone to capture your voice when using speech-to-text input.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OpenCode Mobile (ZeroTier Edition) can attach images from your photo library to messages to your AI coding agent.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OpenCode Mobile (ZeroTier Edition) can capture images with your camera and attach them to messages to your AI coding agent.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OpenCode Mobile (ZeroTier Edition) uses your local network to connect to self-hosted OpenCode servers running on your LAN.
